refnamediv.refpurpose: Set an option for formatting the returned values

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
voidsnmp_set_output_option Snmp\Outputoption boolenable
Enables or disables an option that controls how the Net-SNMP library formats the values and OIDs returned by the SNMP functions, such as snmp2_get or snmp2_real_walk.
A new SNMP object takes its initial output options from the values set with this function. To change an option for a single session, set the corresponding property of the SNMP object instead.

&reftitle.parameters;
option
The option to set. See Snmp\Output for the available options.
enable
Whether to enable the option.
